locationHint.eyes: Pi, imp or burn injury over HP/10 blinds the eye. Other injury goes to the skull without DR: ×4 wounding, over 1/2 HP — knockdown roll at -10 (B420). Miss by 1 hits the torso
locationHint.skull: DR 2 (bone), ×4 wounding, over 1/2 HP — knockdown roll at -10 (B420). Miss by 1 hits the torso
locationHint.face: Injury over 1/2 HT — knockdown roll at -5 (B420). Miss by 1 hits the torso
locationHint.ear: Injury over 1/2 HT — knockdown roll at -5 (B420). Miss by 1 hits the torso. Cutting injury over HP/4 is lost, over HP/2 cuts the ear off.
locationHint.jaw: Injury over 1/2 HT — knockdown roll at -5 (B420). Miss by 1 hits the torso. Crushing gives an extra -1 to the knockdown roll
locationHint.nose: Injury over 1/2 HT — knockdown roll at -5 (B420). Miss by 1 hits the torso. Injury over HP/4 breaks the nose (major wound, B420). Cutting injury over HP/4 is lost, over HP/2 cuts the nose off.
locationHint.groin: Crushing: male targets roll knockdown at -5 (B420), shock doubles up to -8. Miss by 1 hits the torso
locationHint.neck: Crushing ×1.5, cutting ×2. Miss by 1 hits the torso
locationHint.vitals: Imp and pi ×3, beam burn ×2. Injury over 1/2 HP — knockdown roll at -5 (B420). Miss by 1 hits the torso
locationHint.arms: All damage types ×1, injury over HP/2 cripples the limb, excess is lost
locationHint.legs: All damage types ×1, injury over HP/2 cripples the limb, excess is lost
locationHint.wings: All damage types ×1, injury over HP/2 cripples the limb, excess is lost

locationHint.smallJoint: All damage types ×1, injury over HP/4 cripples the extremity, excess is lost. Recovery from crippling at HT-2. Miss by 1 hits the extremity
locationHint.spine: Only cr, cut, imp, pi and beams from behind. Vertebrae give +3 DR, but any penetrating injury requires a knockdown roll at -5 and is a major wound (B420). Injury over HP breaks the spine: automatic knockdown and stun. Miss by 1 hits the torso

locationHint.neckVein: Only cr, cut, imp, pi and beams. Cut and imp ×2.5, pi and beams ×1.5, no injury limit. Miss by 1 hits the neck
locationHint.weapon: Knife, pistol etc. -5; broadsword, mace, carbine etc. -4; spear, greatsword, halberd, rifle etc. -3. Disarming (B401) at an extra -2 for non-fencing weapons. critMissBare.3: You knock yourself out! Details are up to the GM — perhaps you slipped and hit your head, or ran face-first into your opponent's shield or fist. Roll vs. HT every 30 minutes to recover.
critMissBare.4: If you were parrying or attacking with a limb, you strain it: take 1 HP of injury and the limb is "crippled" — you cannot use it to attack or defend for 30 minutes. If you were biting, butting, etc., you pull a muscle and suffer moderate pain (see Irritating Conditions, B428) for (20 - HT) minutes, minimum one minute.
critMissBare.5: You hit a solid object (wall, floor, etc.) instead of striking your foe or parrying his attack. You take thrust crushing damage to the limb used; DR protects normally. Exception: if attacking a foe armed with a ready impaling weapon, you fall on his weapon! You take the weapon's damage, but based on your ST rather than his.
critMissBare.6: You hit a solid object (wall, floor, etc.) instead of striking your foe or parrying his attack. You take half thrust crushing damage to the limb used; DR protects normally. Exception: if attacking with natural weapons such as claws or teeth, they break: -1 damage on future attacks until you heal (for recovery, see Duration of Crippling Injuries, B422).
critMissBare.7: You stumble. If attacking, you advance one yard past your opponent and end your turn facing away from him; he is now behind you! If parrying, you fall down.

critMissBare.13: You drop your guard. All your active defenses are at -2 on the next turn, and any Evaluate bonus or Feint penalty against you until your next turn counts double. This is obvious to nearby opponents.
critMissBare.14: You stumble. If attacking, you advance one yard past your opponent and end your turn facing away from him; he is now behind you! If parrying, you fall down.
critMissBare.15: You tear a muscle. Take 1d-3 of injury to the limb you used (to one limb, if you used two), or to your neck if biting, butting, etc. You are off balance and at -1 to all attacks and defenses for the next turn. You are at -3 to any action involving that limb (or to any action, if you injured your neck!) until this damage heals. Reduce this penalty to -1 if you have High Pain Threshold.
critMissBare.16: You hit a solid object (wall, floor, etc.) instead of striking your foe or parrying his attack. You take thrust crushing damage to the limb used; DR protects normally. Exception: if attacking a foe armed with a ready impaling weapon, you fall on his weapon! You take the weapon's damage, but based on your ST rather than his.
critMissBare.17: If you were parrying or attacking with a limb, you strain it: take 1 HP of injury and the limb is "crippled" — you cannot use it to attack or defend for 30 minutes. Exception: animals with IQ 3-5 miss so badly that they lose their nerve; they flee on their next turn if possible, or try to surrender (exposing throat or belly) if cornered.
